description: MrScraper is a token-billed web scraping platform with a REST API, CLI, SDKs and MCP server.
auth_notes: API token created in the dashboard and sent in the x-api-token header; Marketplace endpoints instead take it as an Authorization Bearer token.
gate_detail: Tokens are generated self-serve in the dashboard after sign-in. Usage draws on subscription-plan token allotments (e.g. Scraper Pro) billed via Stripe; the sources do not say whether a free tier or trial exists.
api_scope: Scraper API endpoints for HTML, Markdown, screenshot, brand and JSON extraction, web search, workflow and bulk scraping, analytics, and token and subscription verification.
mcp_notes: Described as the official MrScraper MCP server for page retrieval, web search and usage; can be connected or run locally as open source.
blocker_detail: Token allotments come from subscription plans; free-trial availability is not stated in the provided text.

evidence.quote: The MrScraper API uses API token authentication to secure all endpoints.
Include your API token in the x-api-token HTTP header on every request:
authenticate using the standard RFC 6750 Authorization header with a Bearer token
Click New Token . Enter a descriptive token name and choose an expiration date . Click Create
If you subscribe to Scraper Pro on January 15th
Official MrScraper MCP server for retrieving web pages, web search, and account usage.

uncertainties: Whether a free tier or trial gives working credentials is not stated in the sources.
MCP server URL is not given.
Sandbox availability is not stated; only a no-code request tester is mentioned.
Webhook support is inferred from a Webhook integration for scraper results.
